lines: Nine-hole-dwelling and one, roaring, pervading, fixed; by this indeed sky-goer venerable yoga-movement is called.
l4.sanskrit_cite: navacchidragataṃ caikaṃ nadantaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhruvam anayā hi khacārī śrīyogasañcāra ucyate
